class.name: Awakened Shaman Class
lore: Choose the Awakened Shaman Class
class.desc_es: Un chamán que cambia entre la postura del Trueno (ataque) y la de la Tierra (curación y protección), con tótems, raíces y manos ancestrales.

skills.name: Soul Link
lore: Power Link (Thunder Stance): Create a spiritual link with the nearest ally, giving them strength.
Life Link (Earth Stance): Create a spiritual link with the nearest ally, constantly healing them.
❤ {heal} Heal
⏱ {healinterval} ticks Heal Interval
skills.desc_es: Pasiva: te vinculas con el aliado más cercano. En Trueno le das fuerza; en Tierra lo vas curando.

skills.name: Primal Combo
lore: Thunder Combo (Thunder Stance): Unleash a chain of thunder:
First & Second Strike: Shoot a thunder strike forward.
Third Strike: Shoot a constant thunder strike forward, lasting
for 2 seconds.
Fourth Strike: Call down a thunder strike at the location
you're looking at.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
Life Combo (Earth Stance): Unleash a chain of beams:
First & Second Strike: Shoot a healing beam forward.
Third Strike: Shoot a constant healing beam forward, lasting
for 2 seconds.
Fourth Strike: Call down a healing beam strike at the location
you're looking at.
❤ {heal} Heal
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: En Trueno: rayos hacia delante, un rayo continuo y uno que cae donde miras. En Tierra: rayos que curan a los aliados.

skills.name: Echo Step
lore: Enter spirit form, swiftly dashing towards your moving direction
for 2 seconds. You are immune to damage while in spirit form.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Entras en forma de espíritu y te deslizas rápido hacia donde te mueves durante 2 segundos, sin recibir daño.

skills.name: Ritual Totem
lore: Hunter Totem (Thunder Stance): Summon a Hunter Totem that
constantly creates small spiritual wisps that are fired towards enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
Guardian Totem (Earth Stance): Summon a Guardian Totem that creates a
shielded area where enemies cannot enter. You and allies are healed
inside the area.
❤ {heal} Heal
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: En Trueno: un tótem cazador que dispara espíritus a los enemigos. En Tierra: un tótem guardián con un escudo que no deja entrar a enemigos y cura a los aliados.

skills.name: Stance Switch
lore: Switch form between Thunder Stance and Earth Stance.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Cambias entre la postura del Trueno y la de la Tierra.

skills.name: Earthen Embrace
lore: Wooden roots emerge from the surface below up to 5 nearby
enemies, entangling them for 2.5 seconds.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Unas raíces brotan bajo hasta 5 enemigos cercanos y los atrapan 2,5 segundos.

skills.name: Ancestral Hands
lore: Thunderous Hands (Thunder Stance): Yellow spiritual hands appear
in a sequence, damaging enemies. A fist hammers down the surface,
slamming enemies. A palm shoots out from the surface below,
knocking up enemies. A final fist smashes the surface,
knocking down and stunning enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
Natural Hands (Earth Stance): Green spiritual hands appear, healing
and protecting allies. Two open palms emerge from the ground,
slightly lifting up allies in that area. Allies are constantly
healed and are immune to damage.
❤ {heal} Heal
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: En Trueno: manos de espíritu golpean el suelo, lanzan por los aires y aturden. En Tierra: manos verdes que curan y protegen a los aliados.
